title: IFS, AI, CWA WRF, and ARWF Short-History Challenger Experts
mission: Build shadow/challenger experts for sources that begin after the pre-2024 development window, without contaminating the core model selection.
steps: Create direct and lightly calibrated challenger forecasts.
Use predeclared 2024/2025/2026 sequencing only after core freeze.
Start with intercept/seasonal bias and strong shrinkage; compare more flexible MOS only when sample supports.
Keep CWA/ARWF prospective shadow until minimum seasonal coverage.
Calculate incremental benefit versus core forecast, not standalone vanity scores.
Define initial rho caps and promotion gates.
acceptance: Each challenger has explicit shadow/capped/promoted/rejected status
Core router remains reproducible without challengers
failure: Insufficient history: collect and shadow only; no flexible model
